_doc: Rules on the EventBridge bus justhodl-system-events, as exported from AWS by ops 6534 (2026-10-17). scripts/event_graph.py treats a rule that sends a detail-type straight to a Lambda as an event edge. Any op that adds a rule on this bus must add it here in the same commit; the coordinator's own catch-all rule is listed for completeness and ignored by the analyzer.
